results.pair_summary: Doc A defines a CFFI callback handler (ir-callback) for processing IR events, while Doc B provides the initialization bridge (init-ir-bridge) to register this specific callback with the external runtime. They are tightly coupled components serving the same FFI integration purpose.
results.integration_rationale: Both files constitute the IR Foreign Function Interface layer within the Delta3 Kernel runtime. Doc B depends directly on Doc A to function. Merging the callback definition (Doc A) into the bridge module (Doc B) eliminates unnecessary package fragmentation, centralizes FFI bindings in a single file, and simplifies dependency management without altering functionality.
